questions.question: Write short notes on the benefits and limitations of secondary processing.
questions.solution_html:
• Benefits & limitations of secondary processing
  • Benefits: longer shelf life, improved sensory quality, value addition, reduced waste
  • convenience.
  • Limitations: nutrient loss, need for equipment, higher cost, contamination risk.
questions.final_answer: Limitations: nutrient loss, need for equipment, higher cost, contamination risk
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the objectives and methods of conventional cooking.
questions.solution_html:
• Objectives & methods of conventional cooking
  • Objectives: improve palatability, digestibility, safety, flavour.
  • Methods: boiling, steaming, baking, roasting, frying, pressure cooking.
questions.final_answer: Methods: boiling, steaming, baking, roasting, frying, pressure cooking
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the LTLT, HTST and UHT methods of pasteurization.
questions.solution_html:
• LTLT, HTST & UHT pasteurization
  • LTLT: 63°C for 30 min.
  • HTST: 72°C for 15 sec.
  • UHT: 135–150°C for 2–5 sec.
questions.final_answer: UHT: 135–150°C for 2–5 sec
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the principle of high-temperature preservation.
questions.solution_html:
• Principle of high-temperature preservation
  • Destroys microorganisms, denatures enzymes, achieves commercial sterility.
  • Used in blanching, pasteurization, sterilization.
questions.final_answer: Used in blanching, pasteurization, sterilization
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the packaging and storage requirements for ketchup.
questions.solution_html:
• Packaging & storage requirements for ketchup
  • Use glass/plastic containers, hot-fill, proper sealing.
  • Store in cool dry place; refrigerate after opening.
questions.final_answer: Store in cool dry place; refrigerate after opening
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Discuss the importance of maintaining proper sugar–pectin–acid balance in / jam making.
questions.solution_html:
• Sugar–pectin–acid balance in jam
  • Affects gel formation, prevents syneresis/crystallization.
  • Ideal: pH 3.0–3.3, 65% TSS, correct pectin level.
  • Essay Questions
questions.final_answer: Essay Questions
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the entire canning process, covering the stages of preparation, / processing, and safety precautions.
questions.solution_html:
• Canning process
  • Selection & grading, washing, peeling, cutting, blanching.
  • Filling, exhausting, sealing, sterilization at 110–121°C, cooling, storage.
  • Safety: hygiene, correct time–temperature, avoid under-processing.
questions.final_answer: Safety: hygiene, correct time–temperature, avoid under-processing
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Discuss the principles, types, and limitations of refrigeration in food / preservation.
questions.solution_html:
• Refrigeration – principles, types, limitations
  • Principle: slows microbial growth by lowering temperature.
  • Types: natural, mechanical, cryogenic.
  • Limitations: energy use, does not kill microbes, temperature fluctuations.
questions.final_answer: Limitations: energy use, does not kill microbes, temperature fluctuations
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the overall contribution of low temperature preservation to modern food / technology.
questions.solution_html:
• Contribution of low-temperature preservation
  • Extends shelf life, retains nutrients and colour, reduces waste.
  • Supports frozen/chilled food industry and global supply chains.
questions.final_answer: Supports frozen/chilled food industry and global supply chains
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe in detail the complete process of marmalade production, including / extraction, boiling, and packaging.
questions.solution_html:
• Marmalade production
  • Washing, peeling, juice extraction, peel cutting.
  • Boiling with sugar, concentrating to 65% TSS, adding peel.
  • Testing endpoint, filling hot, cooling, sealing.
questions.final_answer: Testing endpoint, filling hot, cooling, sealing
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
